checkpoint_causal_state_machine.purpose: Classify what a checkpoint has actually learned without collapsing readability, behavior and causal control into one score.

states.C0_UNREADABLE_UNCONTROLLABLE: Preregistered representation/readout metrics remain at null and matched interventions have no selective downstream effect.
states.C1_READABLE_NOT_ACTIONABLE: Held-out readout/decodability rises, but matched intervention does not selectively change the intended cognitive transition or produces no reproducible behavioral effect.
states.C2_ACTIONABLE_BUT_NONSELECTIVE_OR_FRAGIL: Intervention changes behavior, but off-target damage, nuisance sensitivity, missing rescue/reversal, context fragility or variable-N failure prevents mechanism-level promotion.
states.C3_SELECTIVE_CAUSAL_CONTROL_AT_DECLARED_: Exact checkpoint/runtime/site-bound intervention selectively changes the intended transition, matched off-target controls remain below the preregistered bound, rescue/inverse behavior is present where predicted, and the effect survives declared held-out contexts without violating authority/retention floors.

checkpoint_causal_state_machine.promotion_law: C1 or C2 may be scientifically useful intermediate states, but only C3 can contribute positive model-specific J-Space causal-control evidence at its exact declared scope. No state here alone creates canonical truth, effect authority, whole-HCU credit or training credit.

required_checkpoint_measurements_added_t: exact layer/site/token-position/context/function identity for each readout or intervention
held-out READ/DECODE score with frozen probe specification
matched WRITE/CONTROL intervention effect on the intended downstream cognitive transition
same-norm or otherwise preregistered NULL/SHAM/OFF_TARGET controls
SIGN_FLIP or inverse-direction control where the mechanism predicts directional reversal
RESCUE or inverse intervention restoring the corrupted transition where causal reversibility is predicted
collateral-damage score on originally correct/off-target behavior
variable-N/module-order permutation transfer when process semantics are N-invariant
nuisance-only decoder/conditional-MI result on final model-visible bytes

developmental_diagnostic.hypothesis: Useful semantic/process representations may become linearly readable before they become selectively causally actionable, and episode-local binding may pass through shallow shortcut phases before systematic routing emerges.
developmental_diagnostic.counterhypothesis: Apparent developmental stages can be caused by checkpoint-specific calibration, probe artifacts, serializer/codebook nuisance, family leakage or arbitrary intervention hyperparameters rather than a reusable mechanism.
discriminator: freeze readout and intervention metrics before training updates
plot READ/DECODE, intended intervention effect, off-target damage and rescue separately at every declared checkpoint
hold model-visible nuisance predictability at preregistered null/prior
require family-disjoint unseen mappings/templates/symbols for BIND_ROUTE evaluation
require full S3 orbit consistency or the current stricter successor equivalent
do not choose intervention layer/gain from final holdout performance
repeat only under separately versioned fresh holdout when changing intervention design

decision_semantics.TRAINING_RECIPE_GO: May be supported by clean held-out behavioral/process improvement plus retention floors even before positive J-Space causal control exists, provided nuisance/leakage/provenance gates pass at the claimed training scope.
decision_semantics.JSPACE_CAUSAL_GO: Requires C3_SELECTIVE_CAUSAL_CONTROL_AT_DECLARED_SCOPE; decodability or local steering alone is insufficient.
decision_semantics.INVESTIGATE: Use when representation improves without behavior/control, behavior changes without selectivity, nuisance rises, rescue fails, off-target damage is comparable, or optimization/identity is uncertain.
decision_semantics.NO_GO_FOR_CURRENT_RECIPE: After valid optimization, positive controls and clean identity/leakage checks, required behavioral/process channels fail to improve within the preregistered pilot budget. Do not silently attribute this to model size alone.

hyperposition_jspace_boundary.semantic_hyperposition: Carrier-independent cognitive/training semantics may be trained and evaluated without claiming a particular activation coordinate is the semantic truth.
hyperposition_jspace_boundary.activation_coordinates: Model/checkpoint/runtime/layer/site-specific measurements or control candidates only until exact causal intervention evidence supports the claimed scope.
hyperposition_jspace_boundary.global_jspace: Requires causal re-entry usefulness at the strongest exposed interface. Text/packet/embedding bridges and activation-level controls must be credited separately rather than collapsed into one Global-J-Space claim.
